name: wacz-validator-monorepo

scripts.check: pnpm run check:store-name && pnpm audit --audit-level=moderate && pnpm run test:scripts && pnpm --filter @wacz-validator/contract check && pnpm --filter @wacz-validator/core check && pnpm --filter @wacz-validator/validate-cli check && pnpm --filter @wacz-validator/protocol check && pnpm --filter @wacz-validator/daemon check && pnpm --filter @wacz-validator/devtools check && pnpm --filter @wacz-validator/tui check

//scripts: test:ui / test:report use the root vitest.config.ts, whose `projects` point at
the per-package configs — so the UI shows core, daemon and tui in one run rather
than needing three. `pnpm test` still goes through `pnpm -r test`, then test:scripts.
test:scripts runs the root scripts' own tests (scripts/*.test.mjs) with `node --test`.
scripts/ is not a package, so neither `pnpm -r test` nor the vitest UI can see them.
build-version.test.mjs builds throwaway git repos to check the version a build names.
test:report writes html/ and cannot be opened over file:// — serve it, e.g.
This repo no longer runs a store of its own: the WACZ files live in the shared store
(seaweedfs.crawler-storage), brought up by seaweedfs/scripts/stack.sh. So there is no
docker-compose.yml here and no image pin to compare — check:store-name is what remains,
and it fails when a page or a comment still names a per-repo store (seaweedfs.<project>).
store:wipe empties this repo's bucket in the shared store.
//@types/node: interface augmentation — without it the VSCode TS LSP reports `Property
'dirname' does not exist on type 'ImportMeta'`. pnpm's default hoisting is
per-workspace, so @types/node already declared in packages/*/package.json
is NOT visible from the monorepo root; it must be a direct devDependency
here so a symlink lands at <root>/node_modules/@types/node.
